text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing short-term parking area, designated for Bliss Carman Senior Public School, on the west side of Bellamy Road South, be adjusted to better support student pick-up and drop-off activities for the school. During the course of the investigation, it was noted that there are discrepancies between the posted signs and the by-lawed parking regulations. Recommendations 1, 2 and 3 will correct these inconsistencies.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Bellamy Road South, between a point 66 metres north of Kingston Road and a point 63 metres further north. 2. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Bellamy Road South, between Kingston Road and a point 121 metres north. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Bellamy Road South, between Kingston Road and a point 42 metres north.
